The team has a standing agreement with **Shree Balaji Steel Traders Pvt Ltd (V001)** regarding freight charges that are not explicitly listed on a purchase order:

*   **Freight Limit:** We approve freight charges up to **₹5,000.00 per trip**.
*   **Approval Protocol:** Charges within this limit are approved as invoiced (see precedents SBST/2627/1162 on 2026-04-22 and SBST/2627/1160 on 2026-04-15).
*   **Hold Protocol:** Charges exceeding the ₹5,000.00 limit are considered outside the purchase order and must be held, as demonstrated in case SBST/2526/0956 (dated 2026-03-25), where a charge of ₹7,400.00 resulted in a hold.

This policy has been consistently applied throughout the first quarter of 2026 by team members including Arjun, Sneha, and Priya, as well as by the automated system.
